AutoPlaylist.Name: Create a Hype Tracks playlist
AutoPlaylist.Hint: When enabled, a "Hype Tracks" playlist in Soundboard Only mode is created if it is missing. You can still pick hype tracks from any world playlist.

PauseOthers.Name: Pause other audio during hype tracks
PauseOthers.Hint: Pause any other playing sounds while a hype track plays, and resume them from the same spot when it stops.

NoTrack.Name: When the next combatant has no hype track
NoTrack.Hint: What happens to the music when the turn passes to a combatant without a hype track.
NoTrack.Stop: Stop the hype track and resume paused audio
NoTrack.Keep: Keep the previous hype track playing

Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can change hype tracks.
Errors.NoSound: Could not find that playlist sound.
Errors.CompendiumSound: Hype tracks must come from a playlist in this world, not from a compendium.

Warnings.AutoAdvance: "{playlist}" plays tracks in sequence or shuffled, so when "{sound}" finishes on its own Foundry may start the next track in that playlist. Set the playlist to Soundboard Only to prevent this.

Config.Title: Hype Track: {name}
Config.TrackHint: Plays when this actor's turn starts in combat. Choose None to remove it.
Config.TokenHint: This is an unlinked token, so changes apply to this token only. Choosing None removes the token's own theme, and it falls back to the base actor's theme, if it has one.
Config.NoPlaylists: There are no playlist sounds in this world yet. Add sounds to the Hype Tracks playlist first.
